question: Who among the following became the first fast bowler to take up captaincy of the Australian men’s Test side full-time in November 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pat Cummins.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pat Cummins** became the **first fast bowler** to take up captaincy of the** Australian men's Test side** full-time in **November 2021.**
 
• In **2023, **he led **Australia** to their **sixth World Cup victory. **
 
• As the best-performing **Australian cricket player** of the year, Cummins received the **Allan Border Medal.**
 
• In **November 2021,** he was named **Australia's Test captain **permanently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Steve Smith **had previously served as the **captain of the Australian team** but was stripped of the position due to his involvement in the **ball-tampering scandal in 2018.**
 
• **Nathan Lyon** is a** spin bowler.**
 
 
• **​**In** 2011,** he made his **Test debut. **
 
 
 
• **Tim Paine** was the **previous captain** of the Australian team but resigned from the position due to personal reasons.
 
 
• Paine took home the **2009 ICC Champions Trophy** with Australia.
